name: car_hyper_n2o drive modes
source: [AS] Owner-approved values (2026-10-13, relayed by the racing_game coordinator; assists plan I7, vault PHYS-074): ECO (blue): pedal bend 0.6 -> 0.3, auto-shift up 1800 / 6500 rpm (zero / full throttle), down 1100 / 2800, post-shift clutch close 0.15 s, traction control default On, launch control no, N2O no. Normal (grey): no bend, up 2500 / 8000, down 1300 / 3500, close 0.10 s, TC On, LC no, N2O no. Sport (orange): bend 0.6 -> 0.8, up 3500 / 8100, down 2000 / 5000, close 0.06 s, TC Relaxed, LC yes, N2O yes. Default Normal. The Normal numbers equal car_hyper_n2o's own manual_tcu values (auto_shift thresholds, auto_clutch close_time_s 0.1), so Normal changes nothing but the two gates. The close time maps onto AutoClutchDesc::close_time_s, the post-shift e_auto close rate 1/close_time_s (the shift-close ramp of the torque-following close). The bend composes on top of the car's pedal curve (car_hyper_n2o has none yet). Wing automation stays on in all modes (the Racing assist unit's, independent of the mode). Theme colours are game-side only.
